messages:
marco_sales: FinEdge asks for BYO-KMS POC: customer-kept KEK in HSM, monthly rotation, dual-custody, signed attestation, and pricing delta for HSM egress vs platform keys. Who owns POC?

anya_se: I can take it. Need HSM endpoints (IPs/ports), FIPS level, whether dual-custody == threshold-split, and expected QPS.

lina_eng: Heads-up: direct HSM on the hot path adds ~40-70ms p99. Options: (A) local key-proxy with short-lived wrapped tokens (extra infra + audit surface) or (B) only call HSM at rotation and use platform wrapping for hot ops. We'll need QPS to model cost/latency.

david_security: Legal/GRC checklist: HSM vendor + firmware, FIPS level, attestation artifact type (vendor-signed statement vs raw manifest), rotation proof, audit log retention SLA (we default to 90d), and explicit no-export guarantee from customer. Also require opt-in for fallback KEK in the SOW.

marco_sales: Pricing ask from customer: one-time onboarding + either per-request HSM egress fees on hosted plan or include in Dedicated reserved fee. I'll prepare a delta.

ops_bot: Ticket created: POC-2001 "FinEdge BYO-KMS POC - network & attestation" assigned to @anya_se. ETA draft runbook by 2025-05-01. https://redwood.example.com/t/POC-2001

anya_se: Minimal POC acceptance tests suggested:
1) Customer provides KEK alias and ACLs
2) Redwood performs wrap->unwrap on sample payload; both sides verify audit entries
3) Simulate monthly rotation and validate app fallback to platform KEK for a defined window (30m)
4) Measure p99 latency for token gen with direct HSM vs proxy

marco_sales: Action items: 1) request HSM IPs/ports + FIPS/vendor/firmware, 2) ask legal for attestation spec, 3) get QPS and rotation cadence from FinEdge. I'll circle back after customer reply. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
